hooks.command:
set \
exit 0
v=$(env $(awk 'BEGIN { for (NAME in ENVIRON) if (toupper(NAME) ~ /^GIT_(DIR|WORK_TREE|COMMON_DIR|CONFIG)$/) print "-u", NAME }') git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" config --local --type=bool --get coding-agent-skills.hubGuard); s=$?
test "$s" -le 1 || { awk 'BEGIN { print "hub guard skipped: the opt-in of " ENVIRON["CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"] " could not be read: git config exited with " ARGV[1] > "/dev/stderr" }' "$s"; exit 0; }
test "$v" = true || exit 0; python -B "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/tools/hub_guard.py"
